## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 122 bloated prose blocks are confirmed in 16 paths under tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/. Condense redundant or historical text while retaining non-obvious contracts.

Before-citations use origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84; all impacted blobs equal clean audit HEAD 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396. Implement from current origin/main, retain d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 as immutable before, and use HEAD^..HEAD.

## Boundary and guards
Edit only the anchored ordinary comments/docstrings below and adjacent blank lines. Currentize RED, pre-fix, “Today”, and implementation-scaffolding prose. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged.

Parse base/final files with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); strip only leading Expr(Constant(str)) nodes from Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Tokenizer comparison preserves exact directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 122 editable blocks
- test_rich_text_codec.py (7) — module; test_{over_limit_text_is_fitted_and_marked,wiki_over_limit_value_ends_with_the_marker_and_fits_the_cap,adf_over_limit_value_ends_with_the_marker_within_the_serialized_cap,normalize_outbound_equals_decode_of_to_wire}; comments beginning “Both codecs append” and “The codec law”. Preserve caps, terminal markers, and codec law.
- test_rich_text_cutover.py (6) — module and the five immutable-basis test_* docstrings of at least 35 words from test_codec_law_holds_in_both_modes through test_resolver_lives_in_the_shared_layer_without_cloud_imports.
- test_rich_text_echo_suppression.py (4) — module and test_{lossy_baseline_compare_local_normalized,legacy_body_upgrades_once,cutover_does_not_mass_rewrite_already_synced_bodies}. Preserve lossy-wire convergence and one-time upgrade.
- test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py (7) — module, _is_pure_delegation, and test_{cloud_send_path_composition_is_unchanged,the_sanitizer_applies_the_fit_only_not_the_normalization,non_string_description_still_bypasses_the_codec_entirely,exactly_one_real_map_fields_to_remote_and_it_is_shared,the_shared_layer_names_no_adf_entry_point_at_all}. Replace “Today” phrasing with the current seam.
- test_run_differs_recovery_no_write.py (3) — module, _seed_keyed_pending, test_live_pass_still_performs_recovery_writes. Preserve preview/dry-run zero-write and live contrast.
- test_run_pass_lock_lost_exit.py (4) — module, _lock_lost_cls, test_lock_lost_mid_pass_exits_reschedule_not_error, test_generic_failure_still_exits_one. Preserve keyed exception identity and exit 75/1 split.
- test_timeout_s_forwarding_heldout_7504.py (1) — module. Preserve signature/kwargs forwarding.
- test_transition_replay.py (28) — module; comment beginning “Lazy imports of the module under test”; helpers _write_status_event, _make_tracker, _point_config_at, _FakeTransport; and the 22 immutable-basis test_* docstrings of at least 30 words from test_replay_resume_point_matches_in_jira_name_space through test_recorded_hops_for_reads_self_resolved_store. Replace lazy-import RED history; preserve hop ordering, resume, drift, and transient propagation.
- test_transport_exception_contract_heldout.py (7) — module and all six test_* docstrings from test_backend_http_error_subclasses_urllib_http_error through test_no_core_module_names_a_vendor_exception. State the implemented adapter-neutral exception, deletion, and soft-degradation contract.
- test_transport_param_typing_cc77.py (5) — module, _shim_bound_names, test_{the_only_deliberate_any_is_the_runtime_guard_itself,the_port_is_reachable_by_a_relative_import_from_a_core_module}, and comment beginning “The ONE deliberate Any”. Preserve resolvable port typing and its sole exemption.
- test_transport_port_completeness_heldout.py (13) — module, _core_transport_members, the 10 immutable-basis test_* docstrings of at least 35 words from test_dc_transport_exposes_every_member_the_core_calls through test_a_successful_dc_reporter_write_leaves_the_next_differ_pass_clean, and comment beginning “What DC hands back”. Preserve port census, identity shape, pagination, construction guards, logging, and idempotence.
- test_type_mapping.py (12) — module and all 11 immutable-basis test_* docstrings of at least 29 words, from test_effective_type_map_default_equals_builtin through test_local_type_vocab_derived_from_ticket_type. Preserve map parity, SKIP, fail-closed behavior, and label round-trip.
- test_user_identity_heldout.py (5) — module; test_data_center_{is_authoritative_for_a_resolvable_assignee,converges_on_the_second_pass}; test_identity_models_discover_no_collaborator_by_getattr; comment beginning “assignee resolution is the OUTBOUND role”. Preserve resolver injection and identity distinctions.
- test_wiki_render_corpus.py (5) — module; test_{dc_corpus_protected_excerpts_are_retained,dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical,dc_corpus_coverage_ratios}; comment beginning “NOTE: there is deliberately NO test”. Preserve code excerpts, convergence, richness floors, and corpus-vocabulary boundary.
- test_wiki_render_hardening.py (10) — module; test_{a_non_positive_timeout_falls_back_rather_than_disabling_rendering,a_config_object_without_the_key_falls_back_rather_than_raising,a_timeout_reaps_the_whole_process_group_not_just_the_child,the_child_leads_its_own_process_group,the_unit_is_delivered_on_stdin_with_the_landed_argv,an_empty_stdin_would_have_been_detectable,static_replay_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer}; comments beginning “A REAL executable” and “Separates the 1s timeout”. Preserve bounded/reaped subprocess behavior, stdin delivery, and golden replay.
- test_write_ahead_recovery.py (5) — module, test_keyless_pending_miss_unbinds, test_coordinated_abort_leaves_keyed_pending_recovered_without_search; comments beginning “The unbind lands on the THIRD miss” and “A bare MagicMock answers”. Preserve corroborated absence and create/label recovery ordering.

## Consumers and directives
Pytest collects every module; check_comment_hygiene.py consumes repository prose. test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py structurally inspects production bodies that may contain docstrings; those executable AST checks and production sources remain exact, and no editable test docstring is their input. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Preserve exactly 23 directive tokens/attachments: codec 2 arg-type; cutover 3 arg-type; echo 2 pragmas; lock-lost 1 no-any-return; exception 4 arg-type; typing 1 pragma; completeness 6 attr/method ignores; type-map 1 arg-type; wiki 1 reap pragma; write-ahead 1 union-attr plus 1 must-not-call pragma.

## Independent receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 122 leaf-linked TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session

Citations use full SHAs, every after count is lower, and both verdicts are PASS. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 122 allowlisted blocks/adjacent blanks change, and every block is shorter and current.
- [ ] Normalized AST dumps equal d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84; directives retain exact text/attachment; runtime strings are AST-identical.
- [ ] Sorted HEAD^..HEAD changed paths equal all 16 file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 122 valid passing rows.
- [ ] Path-scoped diff integrity, comment hygiene, and pytest over every impacted file pass.
- [ ] Worktree-venv make verify passes without timeout.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, hygiene, focused, full.
